summary: Expanded the direct public-company universe for the export-controls/sanctions/procurement-compliance node. The clearest US-listed direct exposure found is Descartes Systems Group, whose Visual Compliance / denied-party-screening tools map tightly to export, trade, OFAC, and restricted-party workflows. Thomson Reuters and RELX are larger reference anchors with embedded denied-party, sanctions, KYC/AML, legal, and regulatory data assets, but their market caps and diversified businesses reduce purity.
